authority: #K2-429 sec.3.3: the sec.16.3 four-element plan for the channel-to-chain wiring.
element1_death_cause: the maze re-solves every edge with ONE global frame, so the nets COMPETE for the same space; the per-net channel produced by the planner is never handed to the search => the plan is green but the board is not.
element2_proven_facts: R1224 (authorised N=1 over the R1222 plan): C1=5, C2 clean => plan-green does NOT imply board-green
R1232/R1234: content-aware allocation per NET = 2/5; R1236 (per ROW) = 5/5 conservation
R1188/R1190: the maze's bound rect is passed INTO the search loop (C35) - the existing hard-constraint vehicle

element3_corrected_plan.principle: hand the produced per-net channel to the maze's EXISTING bound-rect input, per edge (hard constraint), so the maze routes INSIDE the channel and cannot compete.
element3_corrected_plan.determinism: channel lookup by net name; no search, no tuning
element3_corrected_plan.conservation: per-channel (this channel's own clear width vs the net's need); domain-level FORBIDDEN
